_meta.description: Fingerprints for detecting Consent Management Platforms (cookie-consent banners) in raw HTML. 'strong' signals are product-specific markers (a named CMP product is present); a hit on any of them sets has_cmp=true. 'weak' signals are generic cookie-banner text/markup used only as a low-confidence fallback (has_cookie_text). All matching is done case-insensitively against the page HTML.
_meta.note: CMP product names double as entity owners; the consent-platform domains also appear in reference/entity_map.json with category='consent'.
